get.description: Report whether the process has completed startup initialization.
Report whether the process is alive without testing downstream dependencies.
Report whether the process can serve requests, including the database when one is configured.

Browser navigation that starts an OIDC authorization-code login with PKCE at the identity provider and redirects there. returnTo is a same-origin relative path opened after login; anything else becomes /. assurance=strong requests two-step verification (teluni-aal2), enrolling an authenticator when needed; assurance=recent also forces a new authentication for operations that need it within five minutes. A lower achieved level redirects to /sign-in?error=assurance_not_met.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: Provider redirect target. Validates the single-use login attempt, state, nonce and PKCE, provisions the application principal, sets the session cookie and redirects to the return path. Failures redirect to /sign-in?error= with login_failed, login_expired, email_unverified, account_unavailable, assurance_not_met or provider_unavailable.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: Describe the current session and return its CSRF token for unsafe requests. A PENDING_LIMIT session must end another session before protected operations. Send x-teluni-activity: background from automatic polling so it does not extend the idle limit.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: End the current session here and at the identity provider and clear the cookie. Requires the session CSRF token in X-CSRF-Token and the panel Origin.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: List the caller's unexpired sessions with minimal timing metadata, newest first.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

delete.description: End one of the caller's sessions, including the current one. Another person's session is reported as not found. Requires the CSRF token and the panel Origin.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: End every session of the caller, here and at the identity provider, and clear the cookie. Requires the CSRF token and the panel Origin.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: OpenID Connect back-channel logout endpoint for the identity provider. A valid, fresh, unreplayed logout token revokes the matching sessions; an invalid one is rejected with 400.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Grant a standard role or one of the company's active access profiles (exactly one of role and profileId) to a membership, over the whole company or explicit active branches, optionally until an expiry instant (no automatic renewal). Requires company administration and two-step verification. Only the responsible administrator, with strong authentication no older than five minutes, may grant company administration, which is always company-wide. Unknown, archived and other companies' branches and profiles are rejected alike. An identical effective grant is returned with 200 instead of duplicated.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Revoke one of a membership's grants; revocation is terminal and an already revoked or expired grant is a no-op. Requires company administration and two-step verification. The responsible administrator and the last active administrator keep company administration.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Propose handing company responsibility to another active company administrator, who must accept it within seven days. Only the responsible administrator, with strong authentication no older than five minutes, may propose; one proposal per company can be pending. Responsibility does not move until the successor accepts.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: The proposed successor accepts responsibility. They must still be an active company administrator with strong authentication no older than five minutes, and the proposer must still be responsible. Other members learn nothing about the transfer.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: The proposer cancels, or the successor declines, a pending responsibility transfer. Responsibility does not change.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: List this company's memberships, including suspended and removed records, by immutable ID. Requires company administration and two-step verification. Presentation names and emails come from the last verified sign-in and never authorize access. Cursors bind the caller, company and collection; access is checked on every page.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

patch.description: Suspend, reactivate or remove a membership with its observed version. Removal is terminal and affects only this company. Actor authority is rechecked under company-first transaction locks. The responsible administrator and last active administrator are protected. Reactivating an administrator requires the responsible administrator with strong authentication no older than five minutes. An unchanged status is a no-op; a lost response requires reloading the member list before another change.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Create a company whose creator becomes its responsible administrator. A repeated Idempotency-Key from the same person with the same content returns the same company; different content is rejected. Further administration requires two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: List companies with a current active membership, newest first by immutable creation time and ID, with the caller's effective roles. Cursors are bound to the caller and collection; membership is checked again on every page. The default page has 50 entries, with a maximum of 100. Other members' companies are never visible.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: Read a company and the caller's current access. A company the caller does not belong to is reported as not found.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

patch.description: Change company settings with the observed version. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: List the branches the caller may see, active first and by name. Branch-scoped members see only their branches. Cursors are bound to the company and caller.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Create a branch; the time zone defaults to the company's. Active branch names are unique within the company regardless of case. A lost response can be reconciled by listing branches. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: Read a branch the caller may see; any other branch is reported as not found.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

patch.description: Rename a branch or change its time zone with the observed version. Archived branches cannot change. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Archive a branch with the observed version, keeping it for references. A branch with active resources, such as paired screens, answers BRANCH_IN_USE. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: List the company's organization audit events, newest first. Company administrators read every event; branch managers read only events that concern their own branches and no other branch. Requires two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: List the company's customized access profiles with how many members and effective grants hold each, active first by name. Archived profiles are included only on request. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Create a customized access profile from delegable capabilities (branches.view, invitations.manage, audit.view, devices.view, devices.manage, media.view, media.upload, media.archive, programming.view, programming.edit, programming.assign, publications.publish); devices.manage needs devices.view, media.upload and media.archive need media.view, and programming.edit, programming.assign and publications.publish need programming.view. Company administration is never delegable through a profile. A profile containing a capability that needs two-step verification requires it of every holder. Active names are unique per company and a company keeps at most 50 active profiles. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: Read an access profile with its current holders (members, scopes and branches of its effective grants, up to 500), so the reach of an edit is visible before it is made. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

patch.description: Rename an active access profile or replace its capabilities with the observed version. Every holder's access follows the change on its next request, and the audit event records the added and removed capabilities and the affected grants. An unchanged request is a no-op. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Archive an access profile with the observed version once no effective grant holds it; archived profiles stay for attribution and cannot be granted or edited. Requires company administration and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Invite a recipient address to the company with one grant: a role over the whole company or explicit active branches, optionally until an expiry instant. Company administrators invite operators and branch managers; only the responsible administrator, with strong authentication no older than five minutes, invites administrators (always company-wide); branch managers invite operators to branches they manage. The invitation is valid for seven days and its email is delivered at least once after commit. One pending invitation per address and company; abuse limits answer RATE_LIMITED.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The company's invitations visible to the caller, newest first, with their delivery state: every invitation for administrators, and operator invitations within the branches they manage for branch managers. Requires two-step verification. Cursors are bound to the company, caller and visible scope.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Replace a pending invitation with a new one to the same address and grant: the previous link stops working, its unsent email is cancelled and the new invitation is valid for seven days. The caller must currently be allowed to create that invitation.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Revoke a pending invitation and cancel its unsent email. Revoking a final invitation is a no-op.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Describe the invitation a credential refers to, without effect, to the signed-in person whose verified email is its recipient. The credential travels only in the body.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Accept an invitation as the signed-in person whose verified email is its recipient. The inviter must still be able to grant it and the company and every branch must be active. Creates a membership, adds the grant to an active one, or refuses a suspended one; a removed person returns through a new membership. Repeating an acceptance returns the same result with 200.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Start pairing a screen. The player sends the SHA-256 of a 256-bit credential it generated and keeps, and its report; the answer carries the code to show (XXXX-XXXX, valid ten minutes, single use) and the enrollment to poll. A hash already bound to a device or an enrollment answers ENROLLMENT_REJECTED. Limited per client address and by the number of pending enrollments.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Poll an enrollment with the credential whose hash started it, at most once per polling interval. Answers pending, paired with the device ID, or expired. Polling too fast answers RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The calling screen's configuration, including the time zone that schedules use: its explicit zone, otherwise its branch's. An active screen receives authorizedUntil, seven days after this successful renewal (AT-15), which it must stop protected playback at. An unlinked screen learns only that it must clear its private content and credential, then confirm the erasure. A screen of a suspended company receives no renewal.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

put.description: Replace the active screen's report of its application, model, display and supported rotations. Reports are device statements, not qualified support.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Confirm, as an unlinked screen, that private content, configuration and the credential were cleared. The server deletes the credential hash, so repeating the call answers DEVICE_UNAUTHORIZED, which the player treats as done.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Register the hash of a new device-generated credential. The current credential keeps working until the new one is first used, so a lost response is safe; repeating the same hash is harmless.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The company's screens the caller may view, newest pairing first: every screen for company-wide access, otherwise those in granted branches. Filter by branch or status. Cursors are bound to the company, caller, visible scope and filters.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Pair the screen showing a code to an active branch the caller manages, with a name and one of the rotations the screen reported. Expired, used, unknown and concurrently claimed codes all answer PAIRING_CODE_INVALID; repeated failures answer RATE_LIMITED. Requires screen management and two-step verification.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: One screen the caller may view. Screens outside the caller's branches answer RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

patch.description: Rename an active screen, change its rotation or set its explicit time zone (null follows the branch) with the observed version. Only rotations the screen reported are accepted.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Move an active screen to another active branch of the same company with the observed version. The caller must manage both branches. Moving to another company is an unlink followed by a new pairing.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Unlink a screen with the observed version: its credential stops working at once except to learn that it must clear and to confirm the erasure, which stays pending until then. This cannot be undone; the screen is paired again with a new code.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Record, for an unlinked screen whose erasure is pending, that it was reset locally. The record stays distinct from an erasure the screen confirmed.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The company's media items the caller may view, newest first: company-wide items and items of granted branches. The library view shows uploads in progress, ready, rejected and failed items; archived shows archived items; trash (company deletion authority only) shows deleted items until their purge; selectable shows ready items only. Filter by kind, scope (company or a branch), tag and name text. Cursors are bound to the company, caller, visible scope and filters.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Admit an upload before sending its bytes: a name, the owning branch (null for the whole company, which needs company-wide upload authority), the declared type and exact size. Images may have up to 20 MiB and videos up to 1 GiB. The item starts UPLOADING; send the file with uploadMediaContent within one hour.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

put.description: Stream the file of an item in UPLOADING as application/octet-stream, with a Content-Length equal to the declared size. A shorter or longer body, or a broken connection, answers MEDIA_UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE and the same request can be repeated. A complete upload moves the item to PROCESSING, where the server inspects and converts it.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: Stream a variant of a media item: the thumbnail, the display rendition that screens play, or the original upload (which needs upload authority on the item). Supports a single byte range and revalidation with the strong ETag. Responses are private and sandboxed.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: One media item the caller may view, with its processing state while it is prepared. Items outside the caller's branches answer RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

patch.description: Rename or retag a media item with the observed version. Tags are stored trimmed, lower-case and sorted, at most ten.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

delete.description: Discard an item that never became usable (still uploading, rejected or failed); its files are deleted at once.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Archive a ready item: it leaves selection lists and keeps working wherever it is already used.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Return an archived item to the library.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Move an archived item to the trash, where it stays restorable for 30 days before its files are purged. Items still protected by programming or publications answer MEDIA_IN_USE and nothing changes. Company administrators only.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Take an item out of the trash before its purge; it returns archived. Company administrators only.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The company's playlists the caller may view, newest first: company playlists for anyone who may view programming, and playlists of granted branches. Filter by scope (company or a branch) and name text. Cursors are bound to the company, caller, visible scope and filters.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Create an empty playlist owned by the company (null branch, which needs company-wide authority) or one branch. The transition is CUT unless FADE is chosen with a duration from 250 to 2,000 ms. The owning scope never changes.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: One playlist the caller may view, with its ordered items, total duration and video count.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

patch.description: Rename a playlist or change its transition with the observed version. A fade duration is sent only together with the transition.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

delete.description: Delete a playlist and its items. A playlist used by a schedule or a default answers PLAYLIST_IN_USE and nothing changes.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

put.description: Replace the whole ordered item list with the observed version, so reordering is one change. New media must be ready and belong to the company or to the playlist's branch; media already in the playlist may stay after being archived. Image items last 1 to 3,600 whole seconds, 10 by default; video items have no duration and play in full. At most 500 items.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The company's programming groups whose whole branch span the caller may view, by name, with their branches and member screens.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Create a programming group covering the whole company or one to 100 active branches. Names are unique within the company, ignoring case. The group starts without screens and with an empty program.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: One programming group. A group the caller can see only partly answers RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

patch.description: Rename a group or change its branch span with the observed version; a span change sends allBranches and, for a fixed span, branchIds. Removing a branch that still has member screens answers GROUP_SPAN_EXCLUDES_DEVICE, and a span the group's schedules cannot use answers PLAYLIST_SCOPE_MISMATCH.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

delete.description: Delete a group without member screens, together with its program.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The group's draft program: per output, its schedules and optional default playlist. It is created with the group at version 1.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

put.description: Replace one output's whole schedule set and default playlist with the observed program version. Overlapping schedules answer SCHEDULE_CONFLICT; use checkScheduleRules to find them. Playlists must belong to the company, or to the group's branch when the span is exactly that branch.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: A screen's programming source: its group, whether individual programming is selected, and the settings version that assignments send. Version 0 means the screen was never assigned. The group is null for a caller who cannot view every branch of its span, while the source still says the screen follows a group.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

put.description: Join or leave a group and select or clear individual programming, with the observed settings version. A screen without a group is always individual. While the destination has no published programming, which is every destination until publication exists, confirmUnpublished must be true; otherwise the answer is ASSIGNMENT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The screen's own draft program, used when it has no group or individual programming is selected. Version 0 means it was never saved. A playlist the caller cannot view, such as one of the screen's previous branch, keeps its id without a summary.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

put.description: Replace one output of the screen's own program with the observed program version; version 0 creates the program. Playlists must belong to the company or to the screen's branch.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Check a schedule set without saving it: schedules whose start equals their end, and each pair of overlapping schedules (by index) with the first local date on which they overlap. Validation uses local wall-clock time, so it holds in every zone.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: Evaluate the screen's current draft source in its time zone (its own, otherwise its branch's) over at most 31 days: ordered segments with what plays, and notes for times moved by daylight saving changes. A group the caller cannot fully view is null, and a playlist the caller cannot view stays without a summary.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: Evaluate the group's draft program in a time zone the caller chooses over at most 31 days, so a group can be previewed before it has screens.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The publications of a group's program, which needs the capability on every branch of its span, newest generation first, with cursor pagination. Needs programming.view. A pruned publication is listed but can no longer be restored.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Publish the current draft of a group's program, which needs the capability on every branch of its span as its next generation, with the content digest from the check. A different digest answers RESOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT; content equal to the latest publication returns it with created false. Problems answer PUBLICATION_INVALID. Needs publications.publish.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Build the publication of the current draft of a group's program, which needs the capability on every branch of its span without saving it: the problems that block it, its counts, the content digest to publish with, whether it equals the latest publication and how many screens follow it. Needs publications.publish.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Publish an earlier retained generation of a group's program, which needs the capability on every branch of its span again as a new generation, after checking its playlists against the program's current reach and its media; the drafts do not change. Content equal to the latest publication returns it with created false. Needs publications.publish.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The publications of a screen's own program, which needs the capability on the screen's branch, newest generation first, with cursor pagination. Needs programming.view. A pruned publication is listed but can no longer be restored.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Publish the current draft of a screen's own program, which needs the capability on the screen's branch as its next generation, with the content digest from the check. A different digest answers RESOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT; content equal to the latest publication returns it with created false. Problems answer PUBLICATION_INVALID. Needs publications.publish.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Build the publication of the current draft of a screen's own program, which needs the capability on the screen's branch without saving it: the problems that block it, its counts, the content digest to publish with, whether it equals the latest publication and how many screens follow it. Needs publications.publish.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Publish an earlier retained generation of a screen's own program, which needs the capability on the screen's branch again as a new generation, after checking its playlists against the program's current reach and its media; the drafts do not change. Content equal to the latest publication returns it with created false. Needs publications.publish.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: One screen's synchronization: connection from its last sync (online up to 90 seconds, then without recent contact, offline after 120), its desired publication and what it last reported as received, staged and active. Reported values are the screen's own statements. Needs devices.view on the screen's branch.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The synchronization of up to 100 named screens, for lists; screens the caller may not view (devices.view) or that are unlinked are omitted.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

post.description: Every 30 seconds: the screen reports what it received, staged and activated, and receives its status, time zone with that zone's UTC offsets, configured rotation, desired publication (null for a source without one, which means neutral output) and a signed authorization statement listing the manifests it may play until the statement expires. A suspended company receives neither a desired publication nor a statement; an unlinked screen must clear itself.

anyOf.description: The UTC offsets of `timeZone` from two days before `serverTime` to 35 days after it: the offset at the start, then one period per transition. Screens resolve local schedule times against these instead of their own time zone data.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The exact manifest bytes (UTF-8 JSON) of the screen's current desired publication; their SHA-256 is the one the statement lists. Any other publication answers RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, after which the screen synchronizes again.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The display rendition of a media item of the screen's current desired publication, with a single byte range for resuming. The strong ETag is the rendition's SHA-256, which the screen verifies with the length against the manifest. At most two downloads per screen at once.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

get.description: The public keys that verify authorization statements, as a JSON Web Key Set, newest first. The screen pins them after pairing and fetches them again when a statement names an unknown key.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a bounded retry is allowed.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-teluni_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque server-managed human session. Loopback development uses teluni_session. Unsafe methods also require the session CSRF token in X-CSRF-Token and a matching Origin.

deviceCredential.description: A screen's own 256-bit credential, generated by the player and registered only as its SHA-256 when enrollment starts (ADR-0027). Never accepted on human routes.
